verses.translation: For the end, a Psalm and Song of David.

translations.ron: Ţie Ţi se cuvine cântare, Dumnezeule, în Sion şi Ţie ţi se va împlini făgăduinţa în Ierusalim.
translations.grk: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυίδ, ᾠδή.

verses.translation: Praise becomes thee, O God, in Sion; and to thee shall the vow be performed.

translations.ron: Auzi rugăciunea mea, către Tine tot trupul va veni.
translations.grk: Σοὶ πρέπει ὕμνος, ὁ Θεὸς ἐν Σιὼν, καὶ σοὶ ἀποδοθήσεται εὐχή.

verses.translation: Hear my prayer; to thee all flesh shall come.

translations.ron: Cuvintele celor fără de lege ne-au biruit pe noi şi nelegiuirile noastre Tu le vei curăţi.
translations.grk: Εἰσάκουσον προσευχῆς μου, πρὸς σὲ πᾶσα σὰρξ ἥξει.

verses.translation: The words of transgressors have overpowered us; but do thou pardon our sins.

translations.ron: Fericit este cel pe care l-ai ales şi l-ai primit; locui-va în curţile Tale.
translations.grk: Λόγοι ἀνόμων ὑπερδυνάμωσαν ἡμᾶς, καὶ τὰς ἀσεβείας ἡμῶν σὺ ἱλάσῃ.

verses.translation: Blessed is he whom thou hast chosen and adopted; he shall dwell in thy courts; we shall be filled with the good things of thy house; thy temple is holy.

translations.ron: Umplea-ne-vom de bunătăţile casei Tale; sfânt este locaşul Tău, minunat în dreptate.
translations.grk: Μακάριος, ὃν ἐξελέξω καὶ προσελάβου, κατασκηνώσει ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς σου· πλησθησόμεθα ἐν τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς τοῦ οἴκου σου, ἅγιος ὁ ναός σου,

verses.translation: Thou art wonderful in righteousness. Hearken to us, O God our Saviour; the hope of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are on the sea afar off:

translations.ron: Auzi-ne pe noi, Dumnezeule, Mântuitorul nostru, nădejdea tuturor marginilor pământului şi a celor de pe mare departe;
translations.grk: θαυμαστὸς ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ. ἐπάκουσον ἡμῶν ὁ Θεὸς ὁ σωτὴρ ἡμῶν, ἡ ἐλπὶς πάντων τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς, καὶ τῶν ἐν θαλάσσῃ μακράν·

verses.translation: who dost establish the mountains in thy strength, being girded about with power;

translations.ron: Cel ce găteşti munţii cu tăria Ta, încins fiind cu putere; Cel ce tulburi adâncul mării şi vuietul valurilor ei.
translations.grk: ἑτοιμάζων ὄρη ἐν τῇ ἰσχύϊ σου, περιεζωσμένος ἐν δυναστείᾳ·

verses.translation: who troublest the depth of the sea, the sounds of its waves.

translations.ron: Tulbura-se-vor neamurile şi se vor spăimânta cei ce locuiesc marginile, de semnele Lui; ieşirile dimineţii şi ale serii le vei veseli.
translations.grk: Ὁ συνταράσσων τὸ κῦτος τῆς θαλάσσης, ἤχους κυμάτων αὐτῆς. Ταραχθήσονται τὰ ἔθνη,

verses.translation: The nations shall be troubled, and they that inhabit the ends of the earth shall be afraid of thy signs; thou wilt cause the outgoings of morning and evening to rejoice.

translations.ron: Cercetat-ai pământul şi l-ai adăpat pe el, bogăţiile lui le-ai înmulţit;
translations.grk: καὶ φοβηθήσονται οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὰ πέρατα ἀπὸ τῶν σημείων σου· ἐξόδους πρωΐας καὶ ἑσπέρας τέρψεις.

verses.translation: Thou hast visited the earth, and saturated it; thou hast abundantly enriched it. The river of God is filled with water; thou hast prepared their food, for thus is the preparation of it.

translations.ron: Râul lui Dumnezeu s-a umplut de apă; gătit-ai hrana lor, că aşa este gătirea Ta.
translations.grk: Ἐπεσκέψω τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐμέθυσας αὐτὴν, ἐπλήθυνας τοῦ πλουτίσαι αὐτήν· ὁ ποταμὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπληρώθη ὑδάτων· ἡτοίμασας τὴν τροφὴν αὐτῶν, ὅτι οὕτως ἡ ἑτοιμασία.

verses.translation: Saturate her furrows, multiply her fruits; the crop springing up shall rejoice in its drops.

translations.ron: Adapă brazdele lui, înmulţeşte roadele lui şi se vor bucura de picături de ploaie, răsărind.
translations.grk: Τοὺς αὔλακας αὐτῆς μέθυσον, πλήθυνον τὰ γεννήματα αὐτῆς, ἐν ταῖς σταγόσιν αὐτῆς εὐφρανθήσεται ἀνατέλλουσα.

verses.translation: Thou wilt bless the crown of the year because of thy goodness; and thy plains shall be filled with fatness.

translations.ron: Vei binecuvânta cununa anului bunătăţii Tale şi câmpiile Tale se vor umple de roade grase.

verses.translation: The mountains of the wilderness shall be enriched; and the hills shall gird themselves with joy.

translations.ron: Îngrăşa-se-vor păşunile pustiei şi cu bucurie dealurile se vor încinge.

verses.translation: The rams of the flock are clothed with wool, and the valleys shall abound in corn; they shall cry aloud, yea they shall sing hymns.

translations.ron: Îmbrăcatu-s-au păşunile cu oi şi văile vor înmulţi grâul; vor striga şi vor cânta.
